params.body:
Closes #474

## Why

The dry run on the box after #472 found 1 of the 9 held sources of Going to School in Phone-Free Europe. All nine addresses are printed on its source page and all nine are held.

The stamp looked for a printed address only where it starts a line. This report sets each entry as one centred sentence with the address after the title, and a long address runs on over the next line. The one source found was the only one whose address stands on a line of its own.

## What changes

`core/report-stamp.mjs`: when an address is not found at the start of a line, it is looked for inside a line (`placesIn`), together with the lines it runs on to. The link then lies over the whole line the address is in, and over the piece on the next line.

- An address on a line of its own is still taken there first, so the reports that already came through are stamped exactly as before.
- A place is free only when none of its lines is taken, so the Ofcom report (`.../childrens`) does not land on the page whose address begins the same (`.../childrens-media-lives`).

## Checked

- New test with the layout of that report's source page: six entries, three of them running on to a second line, one on a line of its own, two that begin the same. It fails without the change.
- Full suite 1722 of 1722, `tsc` clean.
- The designers' files of Going Out, Staying In and The New Status System: the stamped output is byte for byte the same before and after this change. Growing Up in Public: 18 of 18, as before.
- Not run on Going to School in Phone-Free Europe itself: that file is on the box only. The dry run below is the check.

## After the merge, on the box

```
node bin/stamp-reports.mjs going-to-school-in-phone-free-europe --dry
node bin/stamp-reports.mjs
```
